figurative_meaning_en: Foolish, senseless - a special form of insult
similar_in_english: not the sharpest tool in the shed
example_sentences_in_bangla: কমবক্ত, এই সহজ কাজটাও করতে পারছ না?
সে তো কমবক্ত, কোনো জটিল চিন্তা করতে পারে না।
example_sentences_in_english: You fool, can't you even do this simple task?
He's such a dimwit, he can't handle any complex thinking.
note: This appears to be a colloquial or regional insult implying inability to perform even basic tasks, possibly derived from mocking minimal verbal or intellectual capacity.
